definitions.gloss: to reread; to read over again
definitions.explanation: To read something again, often to check for mistakes, refresh one's memory, or understand it better. Compound of {読|よ}む (to read) + {直|なお}す (to redo).

examples.japanese: メールを{読|よ}み{直|なお}した。
{意味|いみ}がわからず、もう{一度|いちど}{読|よ}み{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I didn't understand the meaning, so I read it over again.

examples.japanese: {提出|ていしゅつ}する{前|まえ}に、レポートを{最初|さいしょ}から{読|よ}み{直|なお}して{誤|ご}りを{直|なお}した。
examples.english: Before submitting it, I reread the report from the beginning and fixed the errors.

notes:
Compound of {読|よ}む (to read) + {直|なお}す (to redo, to fix). The ～{直|なお}す suffix means to do an action over again, often to correct or improve on the first attempt.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive; takes を for the thing reread ({手紙|てがみ}を{読|よ}み{直|なお}す).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- もう{一度|いちど}{読|よ}み{直|なお}す: to read it once more
- {最初|さいしょ}から{読|よ}み{直|なお}す: to reread from the start
- {何度|なんど}も{読|よ}み{直|なお}す: to reread many times

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {読|よ}み{返|かえ}す: to read back over — very close in meaning; often interchangeable
- {見直|みなお}す: to look over again; to reassess — broader, not limited to reading text
